title: Bang Tao: Laguna and the West Coast, for Renters and Buyers
excerpt: Bang Tao is Phuket's premium west-coast address. We list 82 homes for rent there at a median of ฿85,000 a month and 45 for sale at a median of ฿21.9 million. What it costs and who it suits.
author: Islander Home Team
content:
Bang Tao, together with neighbouring Cherng Talay and Layan, represents the more polished side of Phuket. The area offers a long sandy beach, the Laguna Phuket resort and golf complex, Boat Avenue and Porto de Phuket for shopping and dining, as well as some of the island's most sought-after villas.

The figures below are based on our listings as of early November 2026.

Renting in Bang Tao

We list 82 homes for rent in Bang Tao, with a median monthly rent of ฿85,000.

Two very different rental markets. A one-bedroom condo has a median monthly rent of ฿27,000, which is close to what you would pay in other areas. A pool villa, with a median rent of ฿180,000, costs about twice as much as one in Chalong. Two-bedroom condos near Laguna fall between these options, with a median rent of ฿77,500.

  • A one-bedroom apartment 1 km from Bang Tao Beach: ฿27,000 a month
  • A three-bedroom house in Cherng Talay: ฿52,000 a month
  • A two-bedroom apartment with a lagoon view at Skypark Laguna: ฿69,000 a month
  • A three-bedroom private pool house near HeadStart: ฿85,000 a month
  • A brand-new four-bedroom pool villa in Bang Jo: ฿150,000 a month

Who Bang Tao suits

  • Buyers and renters who want a well-known address. Laguna and the west-coast beaches are right on the doorstep.
  • Families. Several international schools are just a short drive away.
  • Investors in holiday rentals. Villas near Laguna and the beach are popular with holiday visitors.

The main trade-off is the price. Pool villas are considerably more expensive here than in Rawai, Chalong or inland areas. If you are looking for a more affordable pool villa, see pool villas under ฿80,000 a month, or compare the two areas in Bang Tao or Rawai.
